speaker: Doctor
text: I'm sorry, but I don't have any information about your symptoms or history yet. Can you tell me how long you've been having trouble breathing and if you noticed any blue discoloration around your lips or fingernails? Also, was there anything unusual during your pregnancy or birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to Premature Birth.

Given your gestational age of 32 weeks, C-section delivery, and maternal gestational diabetes, your lungs likely did not have enough time to produce sufficient surfactant. I am requesting a Chest X-Ray to confirm the presence of ground-glass opacities typical of RDS. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
